name: shopify-cart-transform-bundle-app
description: Native Shopify Cart Transform Bundle & Volume Discount App

scripts.build: export DATABASE_URL="$(node -e "const r = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING || process.env.PRISMA_DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL; if (r) { try { const u = new URL(r); u.searchParams.set('schema', 'the_last_bundler'); console.log(u.toString()); } catch (e) { console.log(r); } }")" && shopify app build && prisma generate && prisma db push
scripts.postinstall: export DATABASE_URL="$(node -e "const r = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING || process.env.PRISMA_DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL; if (r) { try { const u = new URL(r); u.searchParams.set('schema', 'the_last_bundler'); console.log(u.toString()); } catch (e) { console.log(r); } }")" && prisma generate
scripts.db:setup: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && npx prisma db push && npx prisma db seed
